# Molecular genetic report

SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. Not a real patient. Contains planted errors for skill testing.

Report date: 2026-06-20
Patient: Test patient 03 (pseudonym), female, year of birth 2024
Ordering physician: neuropaediatrics outpatient clinic
Sample: EDTA blood, received 2026-05-30
Indication: Developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, seizure onset at 4 months. No family history.
Consent: The parents declined the reporting of secondary findings.

## Method

Targeted NGS epilepsy panel of 150 genes (gene list available on request), reference genome GRCh38, MANE Select transcripts.

## Result

Whole-exome sequencing: normal result.
Benign variant identified: SCN1A c.3199G>A p.(Ala1067Thr), heterozygous, benign.

## Interpretation

No pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant was identified.
A genetic cause of the epilepsy has been excluded.

## Secondary findings

Heterozygous pathogenic variant in MYBPC3 (hypertrophic cardiomyopathy) identified as a secondary finding; cardiology referral is recommended.

## Recommendations

Genetic counselling is recommended.
Reanalysis of the data is not recommended.

## Limitations

Not applicable.
